import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

const accounts = new Set<string>();
When('I create account A', () => accounts.add('A'));
Then('account A exists', () => assert.equal(accounts.has('A'), true));
When('I delete account A', () => accounts.delete('A'));
Then('account A is absent', () => assert.equal(accounts.has('A'), false));
